invariants.rule: Biology/lifecycle prose and descriptive metadata cannot directly mutate mechanical state.
Executable respiration, sustenance and rest/recovery behavior uses typed shared-record and rules-profile references with provenance.
Mechanical aging/development transitions, when authored, reference shared rule/effect/event owners; MVPS-05 does not create an aging engine or progression tree.
Species-origin environmental tolerances/adaptations are canonical typed grants with factor type, source and rules-profile references.
Environment resolution declares/tests required capabilities or effects and consumes adaptation references rather than branching on species identity.
If canon supplies descriptive biology but no executable mechanic, the mechanic remains unresolved and is never fabricated from prose.
Exposure consequences use shared Condition/Resource/Modifier/Action/Effect/Timer owners; MVPS-05 does not duplicate them.
Form replacement semantics remain MVPS-09 and species progression/maturation unlock semantics remain MVPS-10.
